votes.sql:
SELECT
    c.rarity,
    c.setCode,
    CASE WHEN c.hasFoil = 1 THEN 'Foil' ELSE 'Non-Foil' END AS version_type,
    AVG(c.convertedManaCost) AS avg_mana_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.purchaseUrls) > 0 THEN c.id END) AS cards_with_retailer_links
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.rarity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.rarity, c.setCode, c.hasFoil
ORDER BY c.rarity, c.setCode, c.hasFoil;

WITH card_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        c.hasFoil,
        c.originalReleaseDate,
        -- Note: Actual price data is not available in the provided schema
        -- purchaseUrls contains marketplace links but not pricing values
        c.uuid,
        c.name
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.hasFoil = 1
)
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-Q%Q', originalReleaseDate) AS quarter,
    'N/A' AS venue,
    NULL AS min_valuation,
    NULL AS max_valuation,
    NULL AS mean_valuation,
    COUNT(*) AS foil_card_count
FROM card_prices
WHERE originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday('now') - julianday(originalReleaseDate) <= 1825
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-Q%Q', originalReleaseDate)
ORDER BY quarter DESC;

WITH foil_cards AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM "cards"
    WHERE hasFoil = 1
),
venue_data AS (
    SELECT
        json_each.key AS venue,
        json_each.value AS url,
        strftime('%Y', REPLACE(originalReleaseDate, '/', '-')) AS year,
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', REPLACE(originalReleaseDate, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter
    FROM foil_cards, json_each(purchaseUrls)
    WHERE purchaseUrls IS NOT NULL AND purchaseUrls != '{}'
)
SELECT
    venue,
    year,
    quarter,
    MIN(url) AS min_price,
    MAX(url) AS max_price,
    AVG(LENGTH(url)) AS avg_price
FROM venue_data
GROUP BY venue, year, quarter
ORDER BY year, quarter, venue;

votes.sql:
SELECT "rarity",
       AVG(json_extract("purchaseUrls", '$.tcgplayer')) AS "average_price"
FROM "cards"
WHERE "rarity" IS NOT NULL
  AND json_extract("purchaseUrls", '$.tcgplayer') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "rarity"
ORDER BY "average_price" DESC;

SELECT c.name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.hasFoil = 1
  AND s.releaseDate >= DATE('now', '-2 years')
ORDER BY c.edhrecRank ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

SELECT name, convertedManaCost AS price
FROM cards
WHERE hasFoil = 1
  AND date(originalReleaseDate) >= date((SELECT MAX(originalReleaseDate) FROM cards), '-2 years')
ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 10;

votes.sql:
WITH set_card_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        s.name AS set_name,
        s.code AS set_code,
        c.convertedManaCost AS price_like_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.code ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC) AS price_rank
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.convertedManaCost IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    set_name,
    name,
    price_like_value AS converted_mana_cost
FROM set_card_prices
WHERE price_rank <= 3
ORDER BY set_name, price_like_value DESC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT c.name AS card_name,
           s.name AS set_name,
           AVG(c.convertedManaCost) AS avg_price
    FROM "cards" c
    JOIN "sets" s ON c.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY c.name, s.name
)
SELECT set_name, card_name, avg_price
FROM (
    SELECT set_name,
           card_name,
           avg_price,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC) AS rn
    FROM card_stats
) WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY set_name, avg_price DESC;

-- Note: This database schema does not contain price/market trend data tables.
-- The available tables (cards, foreign_data, legalities, sets, set_translations, rulings)
-- do not include historical pricing information. This query identifies the set and cards,
-- but cannot return price trends as that data does not exist in this schema.

    c.name AS card_name,
    s.name AS set_name,
    s.code AS set_code,
    c.uuid AS card_uuid,
    c.manaCost,
    c.convertedManaCost,
    c.rarity
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setCode" = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Khans of Tarkir'
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT
    NULL AS average_price,
    NULL AS high_price,
    NULL AS low_price,
    DATE(NULL) AS price_date
FROM "cards"
JOIN "sets" ON "cards"."setCode" = "sets"."code"
WHERE "sets"."name" = 'Khans of Tarkir'
  AND 1 = 0;
